full-trip-support.label: Existing planning service
full-trip-support.title: Need this stay choice checked in the full route?
full-trip-support.body: Full Trip Planning & Ground Support can include this stay decision within a written scope and custom quote. It does not promise live rooms, a fixed hotel price or guest acceptance.

itinerary-review.label: Existing itinerary service
itinerary-review.title: Already have a day-by-day route?
itinerary-review.body: Review My Route checks this connection in the context of your existing itinerary. It does not book transport, supply a vehicle or guarantee a pickup, ticket or timetable.

full-trip-support.label: 现有规划服务
full-trip-support.title: 需要把住宿选择放进整段路线核对吗？
full-trip-support.body: 整段旅行规划与落地支持可在书面范围和定制报价内处理这项住宿决策，但不承诺实时房态、固定酒店价格或一定接待外宾。
full-trip-support.button: 查看整段旅行支持范围

itinerary-review.label: 现有行程服务
itinerary-review.title: 已经有逐日行程了吗？
itinerary-review.body: 行程复核会把这段衔接放回你已有的整条路线检查，但不代订交通、不提供车辆，也不保证接送点、票务或时刻表。

full-trip-support.label: 현재 제공 중인 여행 설계 서비스
full-trip-support.title: 숙소 선택을 전체 동선과 함께 점검할까요?
full-trip-support.body: 전체 여행 설계 및 현지 지원은 서면 범위와 맞춤 견적 안에서 이 숙소 선택을 함께 검토할 수 있습니다. 실시간 객실 재고나 예약 가능 여부, 고정 객실 요금 또는 외국인 투숙 가능 여부를 보장하지 않습니다.

itinerary-review.label: 현재 제공 중인 일정 서비스
itinerary-review.title: 이미 날짜별 일정이 있나요?
itinerary-review.body: 일정 검토는 기존 전체 동선 안에서 이 연결을 점검합니다. 교통편을 대신 예약하거나 차량을 제공하는 서비스가 아니며, 픽업 장소·시간, 교통편 티켓 또는 운행 시간표를 보장하지 않습니다.

forbiddenClaimDefinitions.automatic-or-instant-result: Do not promise an automatic, instant or no-human-review result.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.paid-work-before-scope-payment: Do not imply that paid work starts before scope, delivery timing and payment are confirmed.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.guaranteed-booking-or-availability: Do not guarantee a booking, inventory, price or supplier availability.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.unscoped-ground-support: Do not imply that ground support is included before a written scope and custom quote are confirmed.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.hotel-real-time-availability: Do not claim real-time hotel or room availability.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.hotel-guest-acceptance-guarantee: Do not guarantee that a property will accept a foreign guest.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.hotel-price-room-guarantee: Do not guarantee a hotel price, room type, accessibility feature or property condition.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.vehicle-driver-availability-guarantee: Do not guarantee a vehicle, driver or transfer slot.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.fixed-transfer-price-or-pickup-guarantee: Do not promise a fixed transfer price, pickup point or pickup time without confirmation.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.transport-includes-entry-tickets: Do not imply that transport includes attraction admission, shuttles or uphill access tickets.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.ticket-availability-price-guarantee: Do not claim live ticket inventory or a guaranteed ticket price.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.booking-entry-guarantee: Do not promise successful booking or entry.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.reseller-official-equivalence: Do not describe a reseller as equivalent to an official issuer or channel.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.sensitive-data-first-contact: Do not request passport images, payment data or unredacted booking references in the first contact.
forbiddenClaimDefinitions.fit-verification-claim: Do not imply that a route, site, vehicle or room has already been checked for access, children or older travellers.

spanishGuideServiceLinks.scope: Spanish guides under /es/guias/ that hand the reader, after the answer, to an existing Spanish tour (a product card showing the published price), the attraction booking service (a card showing its fee) or a quote-only service (a body link). Each placement is registered; an unregistered one, or a registered one the guide no longer carries, fails the check.

forbiddenCopy.spanish-speaking-guide: Mention a Spanish-speaking guide only as available in every city of the route, with a supplement by city and season confirmed in the quote (owner, 19 October 2026); never an amount, a starting price or as included.
forbiddenCopy.scarcity-or-queue: Do not claim sell-outs, last places, limited places, queue skipping or hours-long queues.
forbiddenCopy.video-or-phone-call: Do not offer a video or phone call; contact stays in writing.
